note: Status and owner on Kratos are stored in SQLite; JSON is only initial seed / offline preview.

tasks.title: Define three-week challenge and success criteria
tasks.detail: Challenge scope and three-week deadline documented.

tasks.title: Choose vehicle architecture: local safety + Kratos
tasks.detail: ESP32 local stop and Kratos responsibilities planned.

tasks.title: Agree on team roles and handoff workflow
tasks.detail: Responsibilities for Noah and Gage still need confirmation. Assign one owner per active task; do not assume roles for anyone.

tasks.title: Build route simulator with Go now + queued stops
tasks.detail: Browser simulator supports room missions and queue.

tasks.title: Test Pause, Resume, Stop and E-stop simulation
tasks.detail: Automated simulator checks previously passed.

tasks.title: Publish About page and SME team profiles
tasks.detail: About page and team links are live at aintnowaymo.adsuaracloud.com.

tasks.title: Build shared task board and claim workflow
tasks.detail: Build list is on the site. Teammates send updates to Discord with the team sign-in; BJ applies them by pull request.

tasks.title: Measure actual diecast interior and wheelbase
tasks.detail: Record length, width, height, and axle distances. Also record track widths, wheel diameter, wheel-well clearance, roof height, camera openings and ground clearance. Use calipers and photograph the opened shell. Earlier 1:43 numbers are not measurements.

tasks.title: Mock-fit ESP32-S3 Sense, ToF and driver
tasks.detail: Clearance and camera sightline require physical verification. Candidates, not verified: XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense, VL53L7CX ToF, DRV8835 driver. Check antenna clearance near metal.

tasks.title: Confirm battery and motor mounting positions
tasks.detail: Check wheels, drivetrain geometry, and shell closure. Candidate: 1S LiPo, 200 to 300 mAh. Two 6 mm gearmotors may not fit across the axle; compare staggered motors, small gearing or a micro-RC donor drivetrain.

tasks.title: Print first fitted chassis and iterate
tasks.detail: Chassis depends on real diecast measurements. Use the parametric sizing jig. Low profile, motor and battery retention, reachable switch, nothing sharp against the LiPo. Print a test fit first.

tasks.title: Order final matched motors, driver, and wheels
tasks.detail: Avoid committing until actual shell fit is confirmed. Check motor size, stall current, shaft and speed against the DRV8835 driver before buying.

tasks.title: Assemble differential drivetrain
tasks.detail: Verify motion, clearance, and repeatable steering. Differential drive. Test forward, reverse, turns and low-speed stops; find the minimum reliable PWM.

tasks.title: Wire 1S battery, charging, and supply protection
tasks.detail: Verify motor startup current and safe charging. Check voltage sag and ESP32 brownouts. The XIAO battery features alone do not protect against motor current.

tasks.title: Install and verify physical motor-power E-stop
tasks.detail: Real hardware E-stop not yet tested. Must cut motor power physically, work without Wi-Fi, MQTT or Kratos, and block automatic restart. Build before any autonomous driving test.

tasks.title: Fit turn signals and chime hardware
tasks.detail: Keep part footprint and wiring lightweight. Use non-blocking timing so lights and sound never delay obstacle checks. Lowest priority.

tasks.title: Bring up ToF depth sensor on ESP32-S3
tasks.detail: Verify real obstacle readings. VL53L7CX gives an 8x8 grid over about 60 degrees; it is not 360 degree LiDAR.

tasks.title: Integrate IMU and/or wheel odometry
tasks.detail: Select smallest suitable parts, characterize drift. Start with motor timing plus IMU; timing alone will not hold over a 300 ft hallway.

tasks.title: Verify local obstacle-stop and Wi-Fi watchdog
tasks.detail: Must work independently of Kratos connectivity. Stop on a close obstacle, invalid sensor reading, watchdog timeout or E-stop. Prove it with the network disconnected.

tasks.title: Implement landmark or room-marker recognition
tasks.detail: Unique markers needed for reliable localization. Start with two distinct landmarks. Stop safely rather than guess between similar hallways.

tasks.title: Create/inspect Waymo Proxmox LXC
tasks.detail: CT 312 created. Repo is root-owned, the app runs as an unprivileged user, outbound HTTPS works.

tasks.title: Install private MQTT broker and test ESP32-C3 link
tasks.detail: C3 receive-only bench kit prepared; latency not measured. Bench topics are isolated from the real car. Measure round trip, 95th percentile and max, ack rate and reconnect time. Targets: under 150 ms at p95 and 99% acked (not measured).

tasks.title: Deploy website through dedicated Cloudflare Tunnel
tasks.detail: Live at aintnowaymo.adsuaracloud.com through a dedicated Cloudflare Tunnel; app listens on 127.0.0.1 only.

tasks.title: Deploy persistent task board API and SQLite database
tasks.detail: API and SQLite run on CT 312. Live claims are off on purpose: updates go through Discord and a pull request. Keep published, acknowledged and completed commands as separate states.

tasks.title: Secure admin controls and separate guest access
tasks.detail: Keep MQTT private and require backend authorization. Admin issues commands; guests view only. Enforce on the server, not just in the UI.

tasks.title: Connect real ESP32 telemetry and mission history
tasks.detail: Currently simulated and stubbed. Keep measured, estimated and simulated data distinct. A disconnected car must not look live from cached state.

tasks.title: Auto-pull GitHub changes into the container
tasks.detail: Timer installed and running every minute. Waiting on the first real deploy from a merged pull request. A merged pull request is not a live deploy; confirm service health too.

tasks.title: Protect main branch on GitHub
tasks.detail: Pull request and passing check required; no force pushes.

tasks.title: Send team updates from the site to Discord
tasks.detail: Tested live with a real message; sign-in check and rate limits on.

tasks.title: Verify IS room and corridor map on site
tasks.detail: To-scale second-floor map drawn from iPhone and Google Maps measurements; labels still provisional. Lengths are approximate walking estimates, not survey data.

tasks.title: Measure and correct door locations and hallway width
tasks.detail: South wall doors and walls (201-214) set to scale. North wall spacing still needed; hall lengths of about 168 ft and 300 ft are unverified. The hand sketch is authoritative. Mark unsure doors A, B, C with a guessed room number and ?.

tasks.title: Install permitted unique location markers
tasks.detail: Coordinate permission before placing markings. If markers are not allowed, use existing signs or document a marker-free plan.

tasks.title: Teach robot a short supervised hallway route
tasks.detail: Start with 2 nearby room destinations. Reuse the saved map; relocalize only when needed. Confirm the room marker on arrival.

tasks.title: Test stop-for-person and signal behavior
tasks.detail: Only simulated so far. Record failed trials as well as good ones.

tasks.title: Complete two-room autonomous trip with confirmed arrival
tasks.detail: No verified physical mission yet. Record failed trials as well as good ones.

tasks.title: Test network loss and manual emergency stop
tasks.detail: Test on physical car with supervision. Also test safe restart after an interruption. Record failed trials.

tasks.title: Capture evidence, log results, prepare SME presentation
tasks.detail: Final three-week challenge demonstration pending. Record videos, photos, latency, mission counts and failures. Tie the progress gauge to documented milestones.
